correctness.rationale: With J skew symmetric, the actual source SGA adjusted field is (I−τJ)Jz. Singular-vector orthogonal coordinates split the Euler matrix into (1−ητσ²)I−ησR with R²=−I, whose exact squared norm factor is (1−ητσ²)²+η²σ². Solving r²<1 gives η<2τ/(1+τ²σ²), tightest at σ=L; equality has norm-one top block, above expands, establishing both directions. Let s=ηL and u=τL; the sharp inequality s(1+u²)<2u has maximum allowed s=1 at u=1 and adjustment window u±=(1±sqrt(1−s²))/s, product 1. Comparison of exact ceiling with Vater et al general sufficient step τμ²/((1+τ²L²)L²) yields 2(L/μ)². Original independent rational modal/block checks corroborate algebra, not substitute for it.
